_provenance: AUTHORED source of truth for the Operator's Dashboard — the metrics the book steers by or certifies with. book-models/metrics_dashboard_model.py projects ALL ten metrics into the Operator's Dashboard page's table (Appendix D.1, Operator's Reference), grouped by MODE (formative / summative), and holds the page equal to this model with a parity check (run `python3 book-models/metrics_dashboard_model.py verify`). Edit a metric HERE, then regenerate the page table with `... table`. The book's own declared -> generated idiom, applied to its metrics.
inclusion_criterion: A metric belongs iff it is one you STEER BY while the work is in flight (formative) or one you CERTIFY THE RESULT with at maturity (summative) — measured to guide or to judge engineering with MAGE, not merely reported.

_mode_bands.formative: Formative — measured during the work, to steer the next step
_mode_bands.summative: Summative — measured at maturity, a verdict on the result

metrics.name: Missing-Model Metric
metrics.counts: Fraction of tests whose exercised code traces to no model claim — the unmodelled surface — plus its drain curve.
metrics.informs: After each model-loop Epic; steer the next at the biggest orphan cluster.
metrics.healthy_direction: Drains toward 10%-or-under (56% to 7.89% over nine re-runs).
metrics.rationale: Formative: you run the tracer after each model-loop Epic and aim the next Epic at the orphan cluster it surfaces. Feedback that shapes the next step, not a verdict.

metrics.name: Velocity
metrics.informs: Watch the dip where velocity buys hardening.
metrics.healthy_direction: Roughly linear; a hardening dip is expected, not alarming.
metrics.rationale: Formative: commits-per-week reads out throughput week to week, so you steer capacity and read the hardening dip while it happens.

metrics.name: Churn
metrics.counts: Lines added and deleted per week per path.
metrics.informs: Reads which build phase you are in.
metrics.healthy_direction: Peaks at mechanization, then collapses as the environment stabilizes.
metrics.rationale: Formative: the add/delete curve tells you which build phase you are in right now, so you know whether to expect rewrite or stability next.

metrics.name: Model-sync efficacy
metrics.counts: Whether the drift and parity gates keep model equal to code.
metrics.rationale: Formative: the drift and parity gates fire during the work; a red gate steers you to the divergence before it lands. Feedback in the loop, not an end-state score.

metrics.name: Grammar coverage
metrics.counts: Whether the generator exercised every production of the input grammar.
metrics.informs: Watch for corpus holes no line-coverage number reveals.
metrics.rationale: Formative: a generative-validation oracle you watch while building the corpus — an unexercised production steers the next generator tweak.

metrics.name: Model-claim coverage
metrics.counts: Whether generated inputs drove every declared invariant, transition, and edge.
metrics.informs: The saturation oracle for generative validation.
metrics.rationale: Formative: the saturation oracle you steer generative validation by — an unexercised claim tells you which input to generate next.

metrics.name: MBSE navigation token-savings
metrics.counts: Tokens spent to reach an answer, model on versus off.
metrics.informs: Certify the model earned its context budget.
metrics.rationale: Summative: a payoff verdict measured with the model mature. You certify the model earned its context budget; you do not steer the daily loop by it.

metrics.name: Support ratio
metrics.counts: Support-apparatus LoC (tests, lints, docs, infra, tooling) over production LoC.
metrics.informs: Watch the apparatus keeps leading as feature work resumes.
metrics.healthy_direction: Leads production; settles around 3x it at maturity.
metrics.rationale: Both: watched formatively as the apparatus forms (is it still leading?), reported summatively at maturity as the ~3x verdict. Seated in the summative band because its reference number is the mature ratio.

metrics.name: Control growth
metrics.counts: Project-specific lint files and gate scripts, per window.
metrics.informs: Watch the environment still accrete controls.
metrics.rationale: Both: watched formatively as controls accrete one failure class at a time, reported summatively at maturity as the final control count. A trajectory metric — steered by while forming, certified at the end.

metrics.name: Epic-closure rate
metrics.counts: Epics moved into the closed set per week — the finishing rate, not the commit rate.
metrics.informs: Whether an operating-mode shift converts to durable throughput rather than raw output.
metrics.healthy_direction: Rises when the environment absorbs autonomous loops; flat velocity beside a rising closure rate is the healthy anti-decay shape.
metrics.rationale: Both: steered by formatively as an operating-mode shift lands (does the environment convert velocity into finishes rather than raw output?), certified summatively as the loop-mode payoff. Observed over a ~2-week, single-data-point window so far — a direction, not yet a rate; the figures + caveats live in the epic-closure-rate data-claim.
